rows.label: qst701101_msg0001
rows.name:
Hello, young lady. I am Arb.
I am retired now, but I used
to be a shipwright.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0002
rows.name:
This is sudden, but do ships interest
you? My apprentice is building one,
and I hoped you might lend a hand.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0003
rows.name:
A ship, huh... I don't know what I can
do, but if you're having trouble,
I'll help.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0004
rows.name:
Heh heh heh. As I thought: "if it
helps people." What do you wish for
beyond that?

rows.label: qst701101_msg0005
rows.name:
Eh? I haven't really
thought about it... Why?

rows.label: qst701101_msg0006
rows.name:
Because the destiny you draw
in changes with what you value
and what you care about.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0008
rows.name:
Are you saying that fixation...
attachment can bring more than
just joy and prosperity?

rows.label: qst701101_msg0009
rows.name:
When you cling to things already past
and impossible to change, all it gives
rise to is sadness.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0010
rows.name:
And sometimes that sadness
only creates more sadness.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0011
rows.name:
Oh? That's an interesting
way of looking at it.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0012
rows.name:
I get what you mean, but hearing it
from Wadatsumi, with Yuugo always on
his mind, gives me mixed feelings.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0013
rows.name:
Hmm, His Majesty is my everything,
so it's different from attachment.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0016
rows.name:
Everyone... let's not derail
the conversation.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0017
rows.name:
Anyway, young lady, I am interested
in what you will accomplish and what
you will create in the future.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0018
rows.name:
My apprentice Wotta just returned
to residential area. If you'll
help, please visit him.

rows.label: qst701101_msg0019
rows.name:
But never forget why you're helping,
who you're helping, and where
you yourself are headed.
